# Independent review: 331-row pointer source successor

The source/data successor is supported for its bounded two-use scope. It does not qualify the inherited production baseline, frozen 42-use source successor, removed-use authority, security, G11, or release. Base 45bbb3016f631296c08cf0eaa5f54a0e61455cf1; patch SHA-256 378695ad937bd06447162be3e11aaa9733399ce5f130e72dcada9d5318ad59cd; manifest SHA-256 a36fb0be83a1c4f87b27529c8cca87ce7d338aeabc3efccd6ec7a1d0fcd6ee39.

Independent `git apply --check --whitespace=error` and private-index apply succeeded; resulting Git tree ce9966beaf0df30904c973ae7cd43041c9e4c677. All six changed/new path bytes match staged afterimages, hashes and sizes. The full original 331-row file is archived byte-for-byte at SHA de2be594954ea42d5ba7d6b84eaff07c0d6c0797632bfc752492cce8bb6f721c. The original 317 archive remains byte-identical at SHA f511e46130f3376aadf7796365db533eaa0f35979dd99e8abffaf859d8127057. All 331 row identities/order are unchanged; exactly the BreakpointObserver and Breakpoints rows receive the new source binding and preserve their complete immediately prior rows. The other 329 are structurally identical. TypeScript JSON-AST comparison also confirms every raw ledger byte outside those two row nodes and the source-population/history values is unchanged; the prior 25 snapshot-history records remain intact. The test-only change updates the expected population and asserts the 331 archive, the two source successors and their rejection controls.

An independent AST walk over all five occurrences of the two identifiers found the complete import, property declaration, constructor and `_attachOverlay` member texts byte-identical between b6ef and 45bbb (ast-review.json). The code obtains public BreakpointObserver through the supplied ViewContainerRef injector, subscribes to `observe(Breakpoints.HandsetLandscape)` when the overlay is created, applies matching/nonmatching flexible/grow and 8px/0px margin settings, and unsubscribes on destruction. The actual full intervening trigger diff introduces only the pane pointer-policy weak map and `_updatePanelState` branch. The installed 22.1.7 CDK layout declaration exports these public, nondeprecated members. The new pointer change does not modify the identified breakpoint-use call sites; this is a role/source judgment, not a finding that all pointer or overlay behavior is proven.

I independently ran the existing TypeScript 6.0.3 live authored scan with pinned Node 24 against aec05d8f6baf3dfdd92581504291309992abcb89; the entire scan matched the retained 45bbb scan: 509 source files, 1,931 uses and population ca851159f9b9d169de05b1c08436480218198193b2ce10bbdd86d504bcf92495. The 45bbb→aec05 committed change contains no product, scan-helper, successor-test or current-roster file changes; the live scan therefore corroborates the captured product graph, without asserting a later release cutoff. I independently reran the staged current-roster probe: it reported the 331 reviews, 329 live and two retained obligations, preserved frozen 1,736 keys, and 30 targeted source/review/evidence/structural negative controls. The captured baseline probe failed on the old population digest, as expected.

The staged probe calls the actual current scan and `authoredUseReviewEvidence` helpers with a staged reader; it explicitly does not exercise the complete production `currentAuthoredUseAdmission` inherited baseline. The retained browser/observer claims use controlled streams and do not prove native viewport or media-query behavior. Exact hashes and consistent source-review prose cannot by themselves prove the judgment semantically correct; this report independently inspected the relevant source roles and complete local diff. No install, pnpm execution, product runtime, independent dependency-closure freeze, production admission, or separately blocked removed46 work was performed.
